recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future publisher or dictionary-renderer changes should preserve Short Display rows on detailed definition pages because they are the applied resolution for FHIR-31698.
issue_request: FHIR-31698 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for R5 asking that element short descriptions be visible on Detailed Descriptions pages, using Bundle.entry.fullUrl's UUID/OID short text as the motivating example.
initial_application: No HL7/fhir source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-31698 was found. The behavior appears applied through the generated dictionary output: R5 and current CI detailed pages include Short Display rows, while the R4 Bundle detailed page did not.
additional_context: Bundle is in current build scope through source/fhir.ini, and source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml still contains the Bundle.entry.fullUrl short text. The active resource definitions template delegates detailed content to the <%dictionary%> macro, so the visible Short Display row is generated output rather than hand-authored per-resource page content. Zulip discussion supports the same rationale, and no Confluence references or conflicting community evidence were found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk was necessary because current generated detailed pages already expose the short description information requested by the issue.
